title: Folklore: The Affliction
subtitle: A dark fantasy cooperative RPG-adventure through cursed stories and supernatural horrors
tagline: Every shadow hides a monster — venture forth if you dare
loreSummary: You are a band of heroes drawn together by fate, braving the cursed lands plagued by vampires, werewolves, and dark sorcery. Each story reveals a new chapter of affliction threatening the innocent, and only your growing power stands between darkness and ruin.
keyFeatures: Chapter-based narrative stories — each chapter is a self-contained session
No GM required — fully cooperative with scripted encounter decks
Persistent character growth with skill trees and equipment across stories
Unique tactical combat using encounter cards and custom dice
Rich dark fantasy lore featuring vampires, werewolves, and ancient evils

folklore_core.name: Core Campaign (6 Stories)
folklore_core.description: All 6 stories from the core game, spanning approximately 18 chapters of dark fantasy adventure.

folklore_quick.name: Quickstart Stories
folklore_quick.description: The first 4 introductory stories for a focused shorter campaign or a first playthrough.

folklore_dark_tales.name: Dark Tales Expansion
folklore_dark_tales.description: Core campaign plus the Dark Tales expansion, adding 9 more stories for a full extended campaign.

milestones.title: Shadows Gather
milestones.description: The heroes complete their first story, uncovering the dark forces seeping into the land and the nature of the affliction threatening the innocent.

milestones.title: Darkness Deepens
milestones.description: Three stories in, the full breadth of the affliction is revealed and the heroes grow in power, facing increasingly dangerous and supernatural foes.

milestones.title: Edge of Despair
milestones.description: The penultimate stories bring the heroes to the brink, as the source of the affliction prepares its final, terrible move against the realm.

milestones.title: The Affliction Ends
milestones.description: The heroes confront the ultimate evil behind the affliction in a desperate final stand to save the land from eternal darkness.
